elements.element: No obligation on Customer to disclose more favourable third-party offers to Vendor
elements.evidence: "Customer has no obligation to disclose or match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives"

elements.element: No obligation on Customer to match a third-party offer for Vendor (no right of first refusal)
elements.evidence: "has no obligation to disclose or match" — the mandatory "must disclose and match" is removed

elements.element: No other MFN/most-favoured-pricing burden on Customer elsewhere in the clause
elements.evidence: § 7.1 addresses only Fees fixed in Order Forms and prohibited unidentified charges; no MFN duty remains

elements.element: MFN limited to a defined product
elements.evidence: No MFN obligation survives at all; no product-scope limitation is drafted
No duration language appears in revised § 7.2
No carve-out language appears in revised § 7.2

reasons: The single replacement flips the operative duty in § 7.2 so Customer bears no disclose-or-match MFN obligation, fully satisfying the locked preferred level (no MFN burdening Customer).

Change is confined to the offending sentence; the operator flip is the shortest sufficient edit, so the minimality gate holds and no fallback-only mechanics (product scope, 12 months, carve-outs) were imported.

Unrelated commercial terms in § 7.1 (fixed Fees, usage-based unit pricing, prohibition on unidentified charges) remain untouched and effective; no undefined term or dangling mechanic is created, though the retained lead-in "Before engaging another provider" is now merely descriptive — cosmetic only, deletion of the whole sentence was not required.
Fallback is not satisfied on its own terms, but that is immaterial because preferred is met and the two levels are separate bargains.
